name: Myzrael's Allies
summary: Through the keystone, Myzrael declares herself free, though still hidden from her captors. She sends you to Zaruk in Hammerfall, who knows how to summon her.

sections.title: Free but Hidden
sections.body: Myzrael declares that she is free through the keystone. She must gather her strength out of sight. Her captors would overpower and imprison her again if they faced her now. In time, she vows to confront the giants who held her and make them regret keeping her.

sections.title: Zaruk of Hammerfall
sections.body: Myzrael calls you a noble ally and says she will need your aid again in time. When ready, she will have you summon her to the surface. For now, she sends you to Zaruk in Hammerfall, who knows how it can be done.

faq.answer: Myzrael herself speaks through the keystone and tells you to see Zaruk in Hammerfall.
Myzrael says her captors would overpower and imprison her again if they faced her now. She hides while gathering strength.
Zaruk can be found in Hammerfall.

faq.q: What role does Zaruk play for Myzrael?
faq.answer: Myzrael says Zaruk knows how she can be summoned.
